d: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces fresh political controversy as allegations of an “Arab plot” emerge amid tensions over his political future. His supporters and opponents are locked in a heated debate over the role of Arab parties in Israel’s political landscape. Meanwhile, questions are being raised about Qatar and Turkiye and their alleged involvement in efforts to influence Netanyahu’s position.
